subject: Accelerator demo credit bridging & terms negotiation
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@cloudfoundry.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Request: accelerator demo credit bridging & extension

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for a great demo last week. CloudFoundry Labs is in the middle of an accelerator cohort and we hit a higher-than-expected spike in token usage while building our demo flows. The accelerator requires us to show a working integration in the next 3 weeks; we’re close but need an extra 120k token credit (or a short trial extension) to finish the integration and record the final demo.

Quick context: we ramped earlier than planned because a partner invited us to a joint demo slot on Dec 10. We’d like to request either: 1) a one-off 120k token accelerator credit, or 2) a 14-day trial extension on our existing sandbox account.

I’ve attached a short usage forecast and the latest pitch deck so you can see where the tokens will be consumed. If you need, happy to hop on a 20–30 minute call to walk through the milestones.

Thanks — really appreciate any help here.

Best,
Olivia Park
Founder & CEO
CloudFoundry Labs
Attachments: trial_usage_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet), pitch-deck.pdf (pdf)

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Park <olivia@cloudfoundry.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator demo credit bridging & extension

Hi Olivia — thanks for the details and attached forecast. Quick questions so I can escalate this to the accelerator credits committee: 

- Is this for a paid pilot we expect to convert after the cohort, or purely a demo run?
- Can you confirm the primary usage pattern (chat generation vs embeddings vs reranking) — the cost per token differs and affects the approval size.
- Do you have legal constraints on receiving a one-off credit (e.g., require an MSA or PO)?

If it’s conversion-ready and usage is mostly chat generation, I can propose a conditioned 120k credit that vests on two milestones: (A) demo recorded & shared with the cohort by Dec 12, and (B) a follow-up product deep-dive with our solutions engineer within 21 days. Laura, looping you for legal on the minimal paperwork we’d need for a conditional credit.

If it helps, Olivia — we can do a short call this afternoon. I’ve also opened a HubSpot note and will drop the deal link once I have the milestone language.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Growth
Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Park <olivia@cloudfoundry.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator demo credit bridging & extension

Diego, Laura — thanks for the quick reply and for looping legal. Answers below: 

- Conversion expectation: We’re a seed-stage startup; the demo is part of our fundraising and partner outreach. We expect to convert to a paid pilot if the demo goes well; probability estimated ~60%.
- Usage breakdown (estimated next 14 days): chat text gen ~70%, embeddings ~20%, rerank ~10%.
- Legal constraints: We don’t have an enterprise PO for this cohort demo. DocuSign is fine and the team can sign a short SOW or credit agreement.

I’ve attached a short, line-item forecast (rows by day) that maps to the 120k token ask and where tokens will be spent.

We can do a 20-minute call today at 3pm PT if that works for you both.

Appreciate the help — happy to accept conditional terms.

Best,
Olivia
Attachments: trial_usage_forecast.xlsx

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, Olivia Park <olivia@cloudfoundry.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator demo credit bridging & extension

Hi Olivia / Diego,

Thanks for the context. Legal is fine to approve a provisional credit provided we have a short signature stating: 1) the credit amount (120,000 tokens) and 2) two milestones that trigger full usage (demo delivery by Dec 12, and a follow-up technical review within 21 days). We’ll also include a clause that unused tokens expire 30 days after issuance.

I’ve drafted a one-page provisional credit agreement (attached as provisional_credit_agreement.docx). It’s intentionally lightweight: signature block for CloudFoundry Labs, and a line for the Redwood account owner. Once signed, we’ll provision the credit within 48 hours.

Olivia — please review and let me know if you’re comfortable with the milestones and expiry. If yes, I’ll send a DocuSign link for signatures.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: provisional_credit_agreement.docx

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Olivia Park <olivia@cloudfoundry.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: accelerator demo credit bridging & extension

All — I reviewed the forecast and the draft agreement. Approved on behalf of Growth for a provisional 120,000-token credit, conditional on the two milestones Laura listed. Next steps: 

1) Laura to send DocuSign.
2) Olivia to sign and return within 48 hours.
3) Diego to provision credit once signatures complete and add a HubSpot note linking the DocuSign envelope and updated forecast.

Olivia — congrats on getting this far in the cohort. Kicking off the provisional credit now from my side so legal/ops have a short runway to finalize signatures. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DBL-2026-0421

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
